notes.title: We’re In Steam Next Fest — Get Ready for Tethered Chaos!
notes.content:
Hey Brawlers,
Tether Brawl is officially part of Steam Next Fest! Get ready for a whirlwind of cooperative (and competitive) madness where you and your partner are quite literally tethered together. Here’s what you can expect:

[list]
[*] Tether Mechanic: Work in sync—or gently sabotage each other!—as your characters remain linked by a single, unbreakable bond.
[*] Local Multiplayer Focus: Grab a friend for couch co-op fun, or show off your moves against AI if you’re playing solo.
[*] Fast-Paced Rounds: Each match is only 3 minutes, packing maximum excitement into every second.
[/list]

We’ll also be hosting a developer livestream during Next Fest (date TBA), so keep an eye out!  In the meantime, make sure to wishlist Tether Brawl to stay up to date!

—The Tether Brawl Team

notes.title: TETHER BRAWL Demo Is Live — Join the Chaos at Couch Co-op Fest!
notes.content:
Hey Brawlers!

We’re thrilled to announce that the TETHER BRAWL demo is officially live—and just in time for the Couch Co-op Fest! Jump in with a friend, pick one of our two base characters, and brave waves of killer robots in our sci-fi arena. You’re literally tethered together, so cooperation (or sabotage) is part of the fun. With Party Mode on board, there’s endless replayability—no time limits, no holds barred!

Enjoy the fast-paced action, experiment with wacky sports-inspired weapons, and let us know your thoughts in the Community Hub. If you like what you see, please wishlist TETHER BRAWL to stay updated on development milestones and the full release. Your support goes a long way toward helping us deliver the ultimate frenemies experience. Thanks for checking out the demo, and may the best brawler win!
